Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwBlank: Blank chip: a program must be written on it at a computer or with the terminal.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwApogeo: Skill: every kill lowers Heat a lot and gives more XP; Heat rises a little faster.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwCompatibilidad: System: a quarter less rejection and immunodepression per dose, and half again as much passive adaptation XP; Heat rises a little more.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwCentinela: System: Heat of use depends on how much you move; standing still costs far less.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwFiltro: System: visual hallucinations drop to a quarter, at the cost of losing the danger sense and the Heat warning.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwCamaraCriogenica: System: cools almost twice as fast with the implant off; more Heat, lower cap and shorter Overdrive.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwMartillo: Skill: harder melee hits that refund stamina; the weapon wears faster.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwOverclock: Skill: no Overdrive; the hotter the implant runs, the more speed, attack and slowdown; much more neural load.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwTaller: Skill: work mode; crafting, repairing and reading take 25 percent less.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwTerminal: Portable terminal: writes and decompiles firmware anywhere, one battery per use.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwReactor: System: the Heat bar fills 1.5 times slower for long sessions and momentum builds faster; cools much slower.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_BookGuide: With the books in your inventory, no level needed.
